core: eagerly initialize guardian sessions

Initialize the guardian trunk on the first guardian-routed user turn and cap parallel forked review sessions so approval traffic can fan out without spawning unbounded guardian threads.

Verification:
- cargo test -p codex-core guardian::tests::
- cargo test -p codex-core (fails only on the existing js_repl mktemp/dotslash environment issue)
- just fix -p codex-core
- just fmt

feat: upload ephemeral rollouts in /feedback

Add in-memory rollout buffering for ephemeral sessions so /feedback can attach rollout JSONL even when no rollout file exists.

Route app-server-backed feedback submission through feedback/upload, and teach feedback attachments to accept inline attachment bytes alongside file-backed logs.
